definitions.explanation: A person or group sent on a diplomatic or official mission to represent their country or organization. Also refers to the mission itself.

examples.japanese: {使節|しせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧{使節|しせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来日|らいにち}→来日：13060_rainichi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{遣唐使|けんとうし}→遣唐使：16307_kentoushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{送|おく}られた→送る：00742_okuru⟧{使節|しせつ}だった。
examples.english: The kentoshi were envoys sent from Japan to China.

notes:
A formal, somewhat literary term often encountered in history and diplomatic contexts. Different from the homophone ⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧ (facility).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧{使節|しせつ} (diplomatic envoy)
- {使節|しせつ}⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧ (delegation, diplomatic mission group)
- ⟦{特使|とくし}→特使：23491_tokushi⟧ / ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧{使節|しせつ} (special envoy)
- {使節|しせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (send an envoy)
- {使節|しせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (receive an envoy)

HISTORICAL USAGE:
Often seen in Japanese history: ⟦{遣唐使|けんとうし}→遣唐使：16307_kentoushi⟧ (envoys to Tang China), {遣隋使|けんずいし} (envoys to Sui China), {天正遣欧使節|てんしょうけんおうしせつ} (Tensho embassy to Europe).

cross_references.notes: 施設 (しせつ) means facility — same reading, different meaning
